title: etcd 3.0.1 startup failure on Windows 7 64-bit
body:
The following error is seen when trying to start etcd 3.0.1 on Windows 7 64-bit if the `default.etcd` directory tree is not already present:

```
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: etcd Version: 3.0.1
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: Git SHA: a4a52cb
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: Go Version: go1.6.2
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: Go OS/Arch: windows/amd64
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: setting maximum number of CPUs to 8, total number of available CPUs is 8
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 W | etcdmain: no data-dir provided, using default data-dir ./default.etcd
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 N | etcdmain: the server is already initialized as member before, starting as etcd member...
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: listening for peers on http://localhost:2380
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdmain: listening for client requests on localhost:2379
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: name = default
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: data dir = default.etcd
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: member dir = default.etcd/member
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: heartbeat = 100ms
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: election = 1000ms
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: snapshot count = 10000
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: advertise client URLs = http://localhost:2379
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: initial advertise peer URLs = http://localhost:2380
2016-07-02 01:12:50.368813 I | etcdserver: initial cluster = default=http://localhost:2380
2016-07-02 01:12:50.378813 C | etcdserver: create wal error: rename default.etcd/member/wal.tmp default.etcd/member/wa: Access is denied.
```

This will repeatedly fail until you manually rename `default.etcd/member/wal.tmp` to `default.etcd/member/wal`. Then etcd will start normally.

Notably, this problem is **not** seen in etcd 2.3.7 under the same initial conditions.
